  • SIZING INFORMATION: Small to medium lens designed for those with small or average sized face. Those with a wider face may find this style too narrow.

Product Description

A modern classic with an open-minded personality, the Ray-Ban Erika RB4171 sunglasses for men and women are a timeless style built for effortless everyday wear. These small round sunglasses feature a lightweight frame, keyhole bridge, and slim metal temples — the go-to fashion sunglasses for women and men who want retro-inspired design with contemporary versatility and comfort. The soft, oversized round shape complements smaller face shapes, while maintaining a relaxed, easygoing aesthetic that works across casual and fashion-forward looks. Whether you are looking for polarized sunglasses for women, small round sunglasses for men, or small face sunglasses for a sleek everyday look, the Ray-Ban Erika delivers. Available in gradient, polarized, and mirrored lens options — from classic brown sunglasses to bold colors — these trendy sunglasses for women and men suit every occasion. With 100% UV protection, these shades for women and shades for men combine effortless cool with reliable eye protection — the go-to small sunglasses that never compromise on style. Built with Ray-Ban's legendary quality, the Erika is a true investment piece — the perfect gift for anyone who values timeless style. Ideal for driving, beach days, and outdoor activities. Each pair includes a case and cleaning cloth. Click on the Ray-Ban link above the product title to shop the entire Ray-Ban sunglass and eyeglass assortment.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    I’ve been using the Ray-Ban RB4171 Erika Round Sunglasses for a while now, and they’ve become my absolute favorite pair of sunglasses. Right off the bat, they are incredibly stylish. The round shape gives them a classic yet trendy look, and they manage to elevate just about any outfit, whether I’m heading out for a casual day or dressing up for an occasion. These sunglasses have a timeless vibe while still feeling modern, which is something I really appreciate in eyewear.

    One of the things I love most about the Erika sunglasses is how well they sit on my face. I’ve struggled in the past with sunglasses being either too tight and causing headaches or too loose and constantly slipping down my nose. These, however, are perfectly balanced. They fit snugly without being uncomfortable, and they don’t leave those annoying pressure marks on my temples or behind my ears after wearing them for extended periods. It feels like they were designed specifically for me!

    In terms of coverage, these sunglasses do a great job of protecting my eyes. The oversized round shape covers my entire eye area well, providing excellent protection from the sun without being bulky or overwhelming. They’re perfect for outdoor activities, and I’ve noticed that even on the brightest days, I’m not squinting or feeling the need to adjust them constantly. The lenses provide excellent UV protection, which is important to me because I spend a lot of time outside, especially while driving.

    Speaking of driving, these sunglasses are a game changer when it comes to driving, especially toward the sun. I often find myself driving during sunrise or sunset, and these sunglasses really help cut down on the glare without distorting my view. The lenses are dark enough to provide relief from harsh sunlight but not so dark that it’s hard to see clearly, which can sometimes be an issue with other sunglasses. They strike the perfect balance, making driving more comfortable and safer.

    Overall, the Ray-Ban RB4171 Erika Round Sunglasses are an amazing combination of style, comfort, and functionality. They look great, fit well, and offer excellent protection from the sun. Whether I’m driving, out for a walk, or just enjoying a sunny day, these sunglasses are always with me. I highly recommend them for anyone looking for a versatile and fashionable pair of sunglasses that’s as practical as it is stylish.

About this Item

  • SIZING INFORMATION: Small to medium lens designed for those with small or average sized face. Those with a wider face may find this style too narrow.
  • FRAME FEATURES: RB4171 Erika sunglasses for men and women feature a lightweight round transparent light brown frame with a keyhole bridge, paired with brown gradient dark brown lenses that block overhead glare and keep lower vision clear.
  • 100% UV PROTECTION: To protect your eyes from harmful UV rays, these Ray-Ban sunglasses feature lenses coated with 100% UV protection blocking damaging light and providing superior visual clarity.
  • CASE & CLEANING CLOTH INCLUDED: Each pair of Ray-Ban sunglasses come with a cleaning cloth and case to clean and protect your sunglasses from scratches and damage.
  • VISIT THE RAY-BAN BRAND SHOP: Click on the Ray-Ban link above the product title to shop the entire Ray-Ban sunglass and eyeglass assortment.

Product Description

A modern classic with an open-minded personality, the Ray-Ban Erika RB4171 sunglasses for men and women are a timeless style built for effortless everyday wear. These small round sunglasses feature a lightweight frame, keyhole bridge, and slim metal temples — the go-to fashion sunglasses for women and men who want retro-inspired design with contemporary versatility and comfort. The soft, oversized round shape complements smaller face shapes, while maintaining a relaxed, easygoing aesthetic that works across casual and fashion-forward looks. Whether you are looking for polarized sunglasses for women, small round sunglasses for men, or small face sunglasses for a sleek everyday look, the Ray-Ban Erika delivers. Available in gradient, polarized, and mirrored lens options — from classic brown sunglasses to bold colors — these trendy sunglasses for women and men suit every occasion. With 100% UV protection, these shades for women and shades for men combine effortless cool with reliable eye protection — the go-to small sunglasses that never compromise on style. Built with Ray-Ban's legendary quality, the Erika is a true investment piece — the perfect gift for anyone who values timeless style. Ideal for driving, beach days, and outdoor activities. Each pair includes a case and cleaning cloth. Click on the Ray-Ban link above the product title to shop the entire Ray-Ban sunglass and eyeglass assortment.
